text:
alex (Growth Lead): Quick heads-up — launching a search refresh tomorrow 9am PST. Goal: shave CPA by 12-18% with a CTA + LP swap and tightened keyword bids. Need final sign-off on creative and pacing by EOD.

jordan (Ads Ops): Sounds good. Which CTA/LP variant are we shipping? Also confirm daily budget and whether we reallocate from brand.

alex (Growth Lead): We want CTA variant B (shorter, action-forward) + LP variant 2 (simplified hero, faster form). Daily budget initially same as current, then +15% on weekday peak hours. Reallocate 10% from lower-performing retargeting adset.

sam (Designer): Uploaded creatives and a11y checks: https://drive.redwood/creatives/search-relaunch/ — CTA B mock attached. Copy options: `Get started — 2-min setup` or `Try Redwood for free`. Prefer the first.
matt (Growth): Prefer `Get started — 2-min setup` for search. Quick experiment: run 50/50 on headline for first 48h, then pick winner. UTM: `utm_campaign=search_relaunch_q1&utm_variant=ctaB`
jordan (Ads Ops): Cool. I'll set up ad groups to target high-intent 3-5 word queries and pause last week's low-converting keywords. Bids: maintain top-of-page for core terms, reduce match-type broad bids by 25%. Pacing plan:
```
Daily budget: same (phase 1)
Weekday peak: +15% between 12-3pm PST
Reallocate: -10% retargeting -> search
CPA guardrail: 20% above baseline -> auto-pause
```

leo (Analytics): Make sure the LP variant 2 has the new GA4 event `lead_form_started` and `lead_form_completed`. Attribution window: use 7-day click for experiment. I'll add a dashboard tile for next-day pacing and first-touch CPA.

marina (Sales Ops): When a lead comes in from this test, route to SDR queue A if MQL score >=65, else to nurture. Also drop a `source=search_relaunch` tag in the lead payload. Can you confirm CRM field mapping?
jordan (Ads Ops): CRM mapping confirmed — sending test webhook before launch. @marina expect a test lead at 8:20am PST tomorrow.
adops-bot: Campaign "search_relaunch_ctaB" scheduled for 2029-04-10T09:00:00Z — precheck passed. :white_check_mark:

alex (Growth Lead): Two quick asks before sign-off: 1) Sam confirm CTA copy locked (use 2-min setup). 2) Leo confirm dashboard tile created and alert if CPA > 20% baseline.
sam (Designer): CTA copy locked: `Get started — 2-min setup`. LP microcopy updated to reflect faster flow. Uploaded final assets.

leo (Analytics): Dashboard tile done, alert set (Slack #marketing-alerts) for CPA and SERP impression drop.

matt (Growth): I'll monitor first 6 hours and call for a creative swap if CTR < 1.2% on headline A.

jordan (Ads Ops): All set on my side. I'll post final campaign IDs here and pause low performers after 24h if under threshold.
alex (Growth Lead): Great — thanks everyone. If anything weird happens ping me and @marina. :rocket:
